metadata.title: Bott--Chern and Aeppli Cohomology of toroidal groups
metadata.abstract: We compute the Bott--Chern and Aeppli cohomology groups of theta toroidal groups in arbitrary dimensions, obtaining explicit dimension formulas and bases in all bidegrees. For general toroidal groups, we determine the Hausdorff reductions of these cohomology groups and show that they coincide with those of theta toroidal groups. We also compute the Bott--Chern and Aeppli cohomology groups themselves in certain specific bidegrees, without passing to their Hausdorff reductions.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 计算任意维theta环状群的Bott–Chern与Aeppli上同调，给出所有双次数的维数公式和基。对一般环状群确定其Hausdorff约化并证明与theta情形一致，另在若干双次数直接计算未经约化的群。
analysis.breakthrough: 在theta情形完成全部双次数计算，并识别一般情形的Hausdorff约化。
analysis.limitations: 一般环状群的完整上同调仅在特定双次数计算，不能把约化相同理解为原群全部相同。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 与非Kähler复几何和上同调结构相关。
